claims.text: Hospitalized adults or adolescents: 50% dextrose, 50 to 100 mL IV bolus, ± a continuous 5 to 10% dextrose infusion until Sx resolve.
claims.quote: Adults or adolescents who are hospitalized can be treated with 50% dextrose, 50 to 100 mL IV bolus, with or without a continuous infusion of 5 to 10% dextrose solution until symptoms resolve.

claims.text: Prolonged or severe hypoglycemia: hospitalize for a continuous IV dextrose infusion.
claims.quote: Patients with prolonged or severe hypoglycemia should be hospitalized for continuous intravenous dextrose infusion.

claims.text: Severe hypoglycemia from sulfonylurea ingestion: give octreotide along w dextrose.
claims.quote: In cases of severe hypoglycemia due to sulfonylurea ingestion, octreotide should be administered along with dextrose.
